Your Tasks

Does shaping your career in a modern digital company where information security plays a central role sound exciting to you? Would you like to further optimize our security level for over 42 million customers and thus make an important contribution to global data and information security? Then you've come to the right place! As a Junior Security Professional in our Security Governance & Assurance team, which is responsible for the strategic aspects of information security at Mail & Media, you can grow into the following tasks:

- Designing and optimizing security-critical processes: You will optimize our internal security policies and guidelines as well as the BCM (Business Continuity Management) System, taking into account internal and external compliance requirements, state-of-the-art technical options, and the interests and structure of the company.
- Conducting security audits and assessments: You carry out audits and assessments in our internal departments as well as at business partners and suppliers, prepare the results in a target group-oriented manner, and support the closure of identified gaps.
- Increasing security awareness: You will contribute to a continuous increase in security awareness within the company by preparing and conducting training courses and presentations for various technical and non-technical target groups.
- Projects to improve the safety level: You will work on projects that increase the company's safety level.
- Preparation and representation in external audits: You will prepare necessary documentation and represent Mail & Media in external security audits, such as ISO27001.

Your Profile

Are you interested in information security and do you see yourself as an all-rounder and problem solver? Do you have a high affinity for technology and business? Are you open-minded, sociable, and enjoy working with people? Are you characterized by an analytical and structured way of working? Are you able to present complex problems and contexts in a way that is understandable for different target groups? Then we look forward to receiving your application! The following points will increase your chances:

- Degree and training: You have successfully completed or are about to complete a degree in (business) informatics or in a comparable area. You have specialized in information security and/or gained relevant practical experience, e.g., through internships.
- Technical basics and trends: You have sound theoretical technical knowledge and at the same time follow current trends such as AI, digitization, or DevSecOps. You enjoy gaining practical experience that helps you identify security risks in IT infrastructures and propose economic measures.
- Data affinity: You have a high affinity for data and data-driven decisions. Ideally, you have gained experience in the areas of data analysis, data visualization, data science, or process mining during your studies.
- Team player: You are a team player who leads by example at all times. Your commitment, empathy, and continuous willingness to learn will help you gain the necessary trust in the organization.
- Communication skills: Your ability to communicate verbally and in writing in a manner appropriate to the recipient (in German and English, both at C1+ level) rounds off your profile.

Our Benefits

🏢Lived corporate culture: Flat hierarchies, a culture of respect and appreciation, signatories of the Diversity Charter, open communication, and no dress code

🎓Wide range of further training: Internal and external training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning, language courses, talent development programs, conferences, and mentoring

💡 TEC-Campus: Free choice between Linux, Mac, or Windows, slack days, conferences, lecture series, courses, open-source projects, community meetups, and user groups

❤️ Active health care: Wellpass, free internal sports and fitness classes, health days, family & care support services, discounts at fitness centers, mental health first responder, fresh fruit, and drinks for free

🚝Mobility: Subsidy for job bike leasing, job ticket, and relocation service if you live outside Germany

💻Flexible working models: Home office options, flexible working hours, and 30 days of vacation with the option for additional unpaid leave

💰Financial benefits: Corporate benefits, company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits, occupational disability insurance, and various partner discounts

🎉 Events: Summer and winter parties, sports tournaments, and team events

Your Tasks

As a Data Engineer in our Portal BI Team in Karlsruhe, you operate at the core of our data warehouse ecosystem. You integrate new data sources, design and build reliable end-to-end data pipelines, and continuously evolve a scalable, future-ready data platform. You take ownership of data quality and reliability across teams and enable stakeholders to generate insights independently through robust, well-designed data foundations. Working alongside an experienced and collaborative group of data professionals, you help shape the backbone of data-driven decision-making across the company.

You will make a tangible impact through hands-on project work, clear ownership of platform stability and evolution, and by contributing to a strong enablement culture with a focus on self-service BI.

- Onboard new data sources, design data models, and build scalable end-to-end pipelines for analysts and business teams.
- Translate business requirements into robust, reusable, and well-documented data models in close collaboration with stakeholders.
- Continuously evolve our data warehouse landscape using Dagster, dbt, Python, Trino, Impala, S3, GitLab, SQL databases, and Tableau.
- Operate and stabilize pipelines by investigating incidents, resolving data quality issues, and executing historical or long-running computations.
- Maintain and modernize our SQL Server environment, including code refactoring, performance tuning, capacity planning, backup strategies, and data center migrations.

Your tasks

Development and Product

- Transforming and creating a containerized microservice architecture in Java (or other languages)
- Developing new products while combining legacy and monolithic Z1 software with new containerized versions
- Renovating, rebuilding — and making it shine
- Integrating legacy software components (monoliths) into new product solutions
- Proactively planning and developing Z1 products with your team
- Finding new paths and solutions to strengthen our market position

Alignment with Other Teams

- Aligning your work with other R&D teams to ensure a smooth fit in the overall architecture
- Being part of a cross-functional team that isn’t afraid to explore new technologies or thought patterns

Team Building and Leadership

- Helping develop the team to the next level
- Coordinating your team effectively and understanding its capabilities deeply
- Mentoring and guiding team members to deliver the features and results our enterprise customers expect

Miscellaneous / Strategic Thinking

- Analyzing blockers or issues in the development strategy — and preventing them before they happen

Your profile

- You have a modernization mindset: turning complex legacy systems into clean, maintainable architecture
- You have successfully worked and led in a development team for at least 7 years, delivering solutions and products together
- You have at least 5 years of practical experience working with Java. We primarily use Java 21
- You have deep knowledge and understanding of software architectures such as monoliths and microservices
- You have experience with security topics such as PKI, S/MIME, OpenPGP, X.509 certificates, and PGP keys
- Ideally, you already have knowledge of Email, SMTP, JavaMail, and BouncyCastle
- You demonstrate professional proficiency in both English and German (C1 level or higher).

You are proficient with the following technologies:

- Java: Java 21
- Linux: Basic proficiency in Linux commands
- Shell Scripting: ANSI Shell, Bash
- Frameworks: Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Integration
- Message Brokers: NATS / RabbitMQ / Kafka
- Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
- Microservice Design: Experience with microservice architectures
- Monoliths: Experience working with monolithic applications
- Build Tools: Gradle
- Software Testing Methodologies

Knowledge of Smart Cards or Hardware Security Modules is not required but is a great advantage.

Senior Software Developer

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Photo Injector Test Facility PITZ in Zeuthen (near Berlin) is one of the leading international groups for developing modern photo injectors and their applications. Current R&D goals of PITZ include improving the electron source brightness beyond state of the art for X‑ray Free Electron Lasers as well as applications of high brightness beams, e. g. for most modern cancer radiation therapies like FLASH‑RT and SFRT (FLASHlab@PITZ). The Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) is the next-generation, ground-based facility for very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy. It will feature two massive telescope arrays deployed across both the Northern and Southern hemispheres. Operations and scientific data acquisition within the observatory are managed by the Array Control and Data Acquisition (ACADA) system. Within ACADA, the Resource Manager (RM) handles infrastructure administration and system supervision, while the Central Control (CC) orchestrates the execution of astronomical observation workflows.

As software developer, you will work for PITZ to develop server software for the accelerator control system, as well as for the ACADA system's RM and CC subsystems.

About your role:

- Development of server software for the control of different devices at PITZ using the DOOCS API
- Integration of applications into the accelerator control system
- Design and implement core operational subsystems as distributed, container-based software based on structural and behavioural design models
- Develop the orchestration logic to manage dynamic hardware groupings and automate workflows, alongside hierarchical, fault-tolerant architectures for system lifecycles and automated recovery

About you:

- University degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering or related subject, or comparable qualification
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong professional experience in C++ and Java; proficiency in Python is advantageous
- Deep knowledge of OOP, functional programming, data structures, and concurrency/multithreading
- Familiarity with state-machine design patterns and distributed consensus mechanisms.
- Proven background in control systems, real-time programming, process automation, or SCADA architectures
- Experience developing communication protocols for hardware and device interfacing
- Strong proficiency in Linux environments and modern DevOps practices (TDD, CI/CD, build automation, Git)
- Strong English communication skills for collaborating in an international, multi-disciplinary team
- Good German communication skills are preferable

Good reasons to join:

- An international research campus enables you to think outside the box
- Basic, materials and applied research broaden your horizons
- Collaborate with exceptional colleagues and researchers
- Our own particle accelerator

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

In a Nutshell

As a

Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d)
, you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.

Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.

Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.

Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.

Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

You hold an Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role
You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems
You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team
At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way
You're fluent in English and/or German

Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.

Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.

Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.

Kickstart your career: Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized Lepaya trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact.

Sustainability at Core: Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste.

The Essentials: We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more.

Unforgettable Moments: From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style.

Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.

ABOUT USCom2uS Europe GmbH provides marketing, community management and game operations services for a wide selection of mobile games, published by our parent companies Com2uS Holdings and Com2uS. We service all of Europe and the Middle East from our office in Berlin, Germany. Our group headquarter is located in Seoul, South Korea, with further international offices in the USA, Japan, China, and Southeast Asia.
As a major mobile games publisher, our portfolio is diverse: Summoners War is a top-grossing mobile RPG, consistently ranking in the top-20 grossing charts in France and Germany. We also work with major international licenses and IP: Major League Baseball and NBA are our partners, we have some of the best golf and fishing games in the market and Com2uS recently acquired Out of the Park Developments, makers of the world’s most popular Baseball manager game on PC and mobile.
